# Shop Database using SQL

## Project Overview
This project creates a simple shop database using SQL. It includes products, customers, books, members, and orders tables.

## Tools Used
- MySQL
- SQL

## Tasks Performed
- Created databases and tables
- Used primary keys and auto-increment IDs
- Inserted product, customer, book, member, and order records
- Updated and deleted records
- Used SELECT queries with filtering and sorting
- Used DISTINCT, COUNT, MAX, MIN, and AVG functions
- Used JOIN queries between customers and orders
- Found customers with no orders
- Identified products ordered at least once

## Key Learning
I learned SQL CRUD operations, table creation, filtering, sorting, aggregate functions, and joins.

## Conclusion
This project helped me understand how a relational database works and how SQL can answer basic business questions about products, customers, and orders.
